title: Valiance's Shenanigans
description: Hi! This is intended to be a private modpack for me and my friends, a friend who is hosting the server requested a modrinth link to set up things on their end.
body:
# ## Aeronautic just dropped!!
This pack shall explore and utilise the new mod to the best of my capabilities.

## Light-weight
Intended to work on low-end computers, as demanding as Create is the mods surrounding it are light and complimentary to the vision of the pack.
